{"code": "import numpy as np

# Identify rows with invalid age (e.g., -1)
invalid_age_rows = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1]
print("Number of invalid age entries (age = -1):", len(invalid_age_rows))

# Inspect the invalid rows
print(invalid_age_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']])

# Replace -1 with NaN to exclude from mean calculation
sales_df_clean = sales_df.copy()
sales_df_clean['customer_age'] = np.where(sales_df_clean['customer_age'] == -1, np.nan, sales_df_clean['customer_age'])

# Recompute mean age after excluding invalid values
mean_age_clean = sales_df_clean['customer_age'].mean()
print("Mean age (excluding invalid -1 values):", mean_age_clean)"}
